name: ai-ready
description: Audit AI-agent readiness, apply reviewed guidance improvements, and run unattended maker/checker loops (build/review/lessons) in Codex. Checker lenses split by axis and review in parallel without seeing each other; severity is assigned by a deterministic rubric shell, not by the model. Release history lives in CHANGELOG.md.

interface.shortDescription: Audit and safely improve AI-agent guidance.
interface.longDescription: Assess a repository's AI-agent readiness, prepare reviewed guidance improvements, and check documentation freshness without Claude-only hooks.
defaultPrompt: Audit this repository for AI-agent readiness.
Plan the approved improvements from the latest AI-Ready audit.
Check whether this repository's guidance documents are stale.
Use build to build out this approved design across phases and converge it to a PASS verdict.
